method: Read every English sentence and every note in all 24 frozen source entries, including the tagged summaries.
Classify by narrative function and placement, not note length. Preserve grammar, lexical definitions, and contextual explanations.
Parse S from git show HEAD:视频/工具/初稿生成/genNN.py without executing any generator and compare the pre-tag final note with the frozen snapshot.
limitations: This report is a source-text audit; root handles actual video tail-frame inspection.
Video/PDF generation was paused. No rendering, production edits, or pushes were performed.

1. 想要超级高产的水稻 -> 必须让两种水稻杂交（A和B结合）。

3. 怎么破解 -> 必须找到一种“自己没花粉的A（不育水稻）”。
4. 找到之后干嘛 -> 种在田里，让B的花粉吹过来给它授粉。
5. 结果如何 -> 结出超级高产的杂交种子。
因为杂交必须要有不育的母本，袁隆平找到了这株标本；
但花了6年发现，这株标本的后代无法稳定遗传，
实验陷入了死胡同（卡在了这里）
